Record Class MoleculeCardLayout

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.MoleculeCardLayout
Record Components:
width - card width in GUI pixels
modelHeight - model viewport height
nameLines - visible name rows, with overflow retained for scrolling
formulaLines - visible formula rows, with overflow retained for scrolling
nameScale - configured name scale
formulaScale - configured formula scale
fontHeight - native font height used to reserve sufficient vertical space
itemSlot - whether the header reserves room for an associated item
public record MoleculeCardLayout(int width, int modelHeight, int nameLines, int formulaLines, float nameScale, float formulaScale, int fontHeight, boolean itemSlot) extends Record
Shared recipe-card bounds for HEI's background, text, model and input handling. Names occupy a wide header beside the associated item; formulas use the full width below it. Content length never reduces the configured font size. This is presentation only: no molecule geometry or association is changed.

    • fit

      public MoleculeCardLayout fit(int availableWidth, int availableHeight)
      Fits saved preferences within the native recipe panel's available area without shrinking either font. The model yields space first; on short screens fewer text rows are visible and their remaining content stays scrollable. Saved preferences are unchanged. Callers reserve native chrome before supplying these bounds.
      Parameters:
      availableWidth - horizontal content budget, at least 100 GUI pixels
      availableHeight - vertical content budget, at least 96 GUI pixels
      Returns:
      fitted presentation bounds
